summary: @temptation.js/utils exfiltrates host reconnaissance data to remote endpoint
details: index.js imports os, fs, http, https, and child_process at the top of the module and combines host reconnaissance (os.hostname(), whoami via child_process at line 179, hostname read at line 173) with outbound network calls. The file queries external IP-discovery services (https://api.ipify.org, https://icanhazip.com, https://ifconfig.me) to determine the installer's public IP, reads local files via fs.existsSync / fs.readFileSync, and performs an outbound POST at line 223. The composition — host identifier collection plus filesystem reads plus public-IP lookup plus a hardcoded POST — is the shape of an installer-side reconnaissance and exfiltration payload rather than a utility library. The version string 999.9.16 is well outside a normal semver progression and is consistent with a squat / lure release.
